SELF_REVIEW_PASSED for R02: no scope, pin, installed-runtime or authority change.
A repeated blocked document can prove its resume state is eligible, but
historical checkpoint preservation still requires comparing durable prior
state; a single Markdown snapshot cannot prove its own history. Cyclic authority
links do not skip edge checks: each node is fully validated once on its traversal
path and every edge is checked before the outer result can pass.
Full docs:all passed: 72 tests, zero failures/skips, 6984.439625 ms.
